title: The Cloud That Weighs Tons
short_teaser: A cloud looks weightless, yet it contains a vast number of tiny water droplets.
story: A cloud looks weightless, yet it contains a vast number of tiny water droplets. Because the droplets are spread through a large volume and supported by moving air, the mass does not behave like a solid object falling at once. Appearance can hide both scale and structure. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Appearance can hide both scale and structure. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
spark_application: Spend five quiet minutes noticing something that creates awe, surprise, or delight. Save one sentence about what shifted in your perspective. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
